name: Epiroc AB (Class A)

R1.just: Capital-light industrial with ~20% operating margins and growing aftermarket/service mix, but margins do not structurally scale with volume like software/networks — no 2.0.

R2.just: Mining equipment/automation rides secular tailwinds (electrification, copper/battery-metal demand, automation) with mining demand expected to stay high per Q1 2026 outlook.

R3.just: Global #1/#2 in mining and rock-excavation equipment alongside Sandvik, durable share but a true duopoly peer prevents 2.0.

R4.just: Wide moat from installed base, high switching costs in mission-critical underground equipment, ~65-70% recurring aftermarket revenue and automation IP — durable but replicable over decades vs Sandvik, no 2.0.

R5.just: FY2025 +2% organic and Q1 2026 orders +23% organic show genuine organic engine, though reported revenue -8% on FX and bolt-on M&A is a recurring growth lever.

R6.just: Highly diversified across geographies and a fragmented mining/construction customer base with no single client >10-15% and broad commodity exposure.

R7.just: ROCE 18.9% (FY2025) well above WACC, ND/EBITDA 0.71, FCF margin ~14%; strong returns on a moderately capital-intensive base, FCF/NI healthy.

R8.just: Pristine balance sheet: net debt ~$1.1bn, ND/EBITDA 0.71x, comfortably below 2x though not net cash.

R9.just: Clean IFRS reporting, no adjusted-EPS games, SBC immaterial at ~0.4% of FCF (well under 15% hard threshold); high accounting quality.

R10.just: Disciplined Investor-sphere governance, consistent ROCE focus, dividends plus opportunistic bolt-ons rather than empire-building, strong capital allocation track record.

amplification_note: R3 and R4 are strong (durable #1/#2 with installed-base switching costs), but R1 is only base-level (no software-like operating leverage) and the position is a duopoly with Sandvik rather than monstrous solo dominance, so the three rules do not reinforce into a monstrous, irreplicable advantage.
moat_one_line: Mission-critical underground mining equipment with a large locked-in installed base driving ~65-70% high-margin aftermarket/service revenue and growing automation/electrification IP, creating high switching costs.
thesis_3lines: Calidad: lider global #1/#2 en equipos de mineria con foso de costes de cambio, ROCE 18.9%, margenes ~20% y balance impecable (ND/EBITDA 0.71x) con contabilidad IFRS limpia y SBC inmaterial.

Motor de crecimiento: vientos seculares de electrificacion/automatizacion y demanda de metales con pedidos Q1 2026 +23% organico (la caida -8% reportada es solo FX, no demanda) y aftermarket recurrente ~65-70%.
Valoracion/retorno: fwd P/E ~32x (PEG 2.37) y ~+25% sobre su media historica con la accion a ~-2.6% de maximos — calidad cara, sin margen de seguridad a precio actual.
bear_case_strongest: El negocio sigue siendo ciclico y dependiente de los precios de las materias primas/capex minero, y a fwd P/E ~32x con PEG 2.37 y la accion en maximos historicos se paga precio de perfeccion por una empresa cuyos ingresos reportados ya caen -8%, dejando nula proteccion si el ciclo minero se revierte.
notes: Total re-score = 14.0/13.5 raw before cap; capped at 13.5 ceiling. Sum of R1-R10: 1.0+1.5+1.5+1.5+1.0+1.5+1.5+1.5+1.5+1.5 = 14.0. Verified data confirms FASE 1 preliminary (12.5) understated quality slightly; balance sheet, accounting (SBC 0.4% FCF), and diversification all merit 1.5. No 2.0 awarded: R1 lacks software-like scaling, R3/R4 are duopoly-strong not monstrously irreplicable. Key caveat: not_depressed — trades at premium (fwd P/E ~32, PEG 2.37) near ATH with reported revenue -8% (FX-driven; organic orders +23%). Cyclical commodity exposure is the central risk. SBC immaterial -> R9 full marks, no hard-rule penalty. fwd_pe_5y_avg and FCF figures are estimated/aggregator-sourced (MIXED data quality).
